title: 第二十八章 乱葬沟归名
novel_title: 坟头开铺，我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
content_zh:
血煞童子四个字，让乱葬沟边的风都像停了一下。

    燕不归没有当场解释。他确实不能说太多。

    “十年前有一桩旧案。”他只道，“卷宗被封，牵涉白道。玄司留下的，只是几个禁词。血煞童子就是其中一个。”

    沈清萝问：“你能查？”

    “能试。”

    “试多久？”

    燕不归看她。

    “你以为玄司旧档是你家账本，翻开就看？”

    “我家账本也不是谁都能翻。”

    铁柱抱着账本点头。

    “不能。”

    沈清萝把视线收回，转向乱葬沟。

    “旧案以后查。现在先管眼前的。”

    沟边七块骨牌排成一列。

    阿泥、阿满、阿七、阿桥、阿灯，还有两个暂时只记得衣色的小魂，一个叫灰衣，一个叫小药童。

    燕不归皱眉看着那几个名字。

    “临名不能正式入卷。”

    沈清萝把木牌扶正。

    “我知道。”

    “玄司没有这个规矩。”

    “那就先不走玄司规矩。”

    燕不归脸色一沉。

    沈清萝抬头看他。

    “我不是改你们玄司。我只是在这块木牌上写几个字。等你们查出真名，再换。”

    燕不归没说话。

    谢无咎淡淡道：“临名很弱。清虚再来一次，照样能破。”

    “弱也比没有强。”

    沈清萝蘸了朱砂，在木牌上写：城北无名七魂，暂寄此处，待查真名。

    字不算好看。

    但一笔一画很稳。

    写到“无名”两个字时，她笔锋顿了一下。

    这两个字最不该往孩子身上落。可眼下，她也只能先认了这两个字，再一点点把它们换掉。

    阿青飘在旁边，开始念名。

    “阿泥。”

    木牌亮了一点。

    “阿满。”

    第二点灯火浮起来。

    “阿七，阿桥，阿灯，灰衣，小药童。”

    每念一个，骨牌旁便亮起一点微光。

    七点微光排在木牌下，挤挤挨挨，像七个怕黑的孩子凑在一盏灯旁边。

    糖糕蹲在木牌顶上，装得很威严。

    “为什么没有叫鱼干的？”

    沈清萝头也不抬：“你闭嘴。”

    糖糕不满：“本仙镇场，也该有命名权。”

    铁柱道：“没有。”

    沈清萝写完最后一笔，把守墓玉印按在木牌下方。

    玉印刚落下，那枚完整清虚符纹忽然退了半寸。

    像被什么东西烫到。

    沈清萝一愣。

    谢无咎看见了。

    燕不归也看见了。
content_en:
The words "bloody boy" made the wind beside the mass grave seem to stop for a moment.

    Yan Bugui did not explain on the spot. He really couldn't say much.

    "There was an old case ten years ago." He only said, "The file was sealed and Bai Dao was involved. All Xuan Si left behind were a few forbidden words. The Blood Fiend Boy was one of them."

    Shen Qingluo asked: "Can you check?"

    "I can try."

    "Try for how long?"

    Yan Bugui looked at her.

    "Do you think Xuansi's old files are your account books, just open them and read them?"

    "Not everyone can open my account books."

    Tie Zhu nodded while holding the account book.

    "Can't."

    Shen Qingluo withdrew her gaze and turned to the mass grave.

    "Old cases will be investigated later. For now, focus on the immediate one."

    Seven dominoes are lined up beside the ditch.

    Ah Ni, Ah Man, Ah Qi, Ah Qiao, Ah Deng, and two little souls who can only remember the color of their clothes for the time being, one is called Hui Yi and the other is Little Yaotong.

    Yan Bugui frowned and looked at the names.

    "You can't be formally included in the roll by name."

    Shen Qingluo straightened the wooden sign.

    "I know."

    "Xuanji doesn't have this rule."

    "Then don't follow Xuansi's rules first."

    Yan Bugui's face darkened.

    Shen Qingluo looked up at him.

    "I'm not changing your Xuansi. I'm just writing a few words on this wooden sign. I'll change it after you find out the real name."

    Yan Bugui said nothing.

    Xie Wujiu said calmly: "Lin Ming is very weak. Qingxu can still break it if he attacks it again."

    "Weakness is better than nothing."

    Shen Qingluo dipped it in cinnabar and wrote on the wooden sign: The seven unknown souls in the north of the city are temporarily sent here, pending the investigation of their true names.

    The handwriting is not pretty.

    But the strokes are very stable.

    When she came to the word "unnamed", she paused.

    These two words should never be applied to children. But now, she can only recognize these two words first, and then replace them little by little.

    Ah Qing floated beside him and started to read names.

    "A Ni."

    The wooden sign lights up a little.

    "Aman."

    The second light floated up.

    "Ah Qi, Ah Qiao, Ah Deng, Hui Yi, little medicine boy."

    Every time you read one, a little light will light up next to the dominoes.

    The seven-o'clock dim lights are lined up under the wooden sign, crowded together, like seven children who are afraid of the dark huddled next to a lamp.

    Tang Cake squatted on top of the wooden sign, pretending to be dignified.

    "Why isn't there anything called dried fish?"

    Shen Qingluo didn't even raise her head: "Shut up."

    Tang Cake was dissatisfied: "This fairy town should also have the right to name it."

    Tie Zhu said: "No."

    Shen Qingluo finished writing the last stroke and pressed the jade seal guarding the tomb under the wooden sign.

    As soon as the jade seal fell, the complete Qingxu rune suddenly retreated half an inch.

    Like being burned by something.

    Shen Qingluo was stunned.

    Xie Wujiu saw it.

    Yan Bugui also saw it.
title_en: Chapter 28: The mass grave is named
